resolution_rules.ambiguous: Ask a clarifying question and list likely options
resolution_rules.unknown: Do not invent; ask for clarification
resolution_rules.unverified: Show as a candidate and ask for confirmation
resolution_rules.privacy: Do not provide bypass instructions for restricted hostel access
resolution_rules.unknown_locations: Allow likely candidate selection and manual descriptions; manual descriptions remain unverified until confirmed
resolution_rules.broad_reports: Clarify whether scope is campus-wide or limited to specific buildings/floors before finalizing
resolution_rules.manual_location_submission: Students may submit any location description. Always mark it UNVERIFIED, preserve the original text, and ask the student to confirm or clarify it again. Do not treat the location as canonical or verified until confirmation.

pending_questions: Should users be allowed to submit unknown locations as unverified candidates, or only select existing candidates?

location_resolution.detail_goal: Resolve as precisely as available evidence supports
location_resolution.ambiguous_match_policy: Ask a clarifying question and list likely options
location_resolution.unknown_match_policy: Offer likely candidates and allow a manually entered description saved as unverified
location_resolution.manual_resolution: Allow any manually entered location description, preserve original text, mark UNVERIFIED, and ask a follow-up confirmation/clarification question before treating it as resolved.
location_resolution.broad_report_policy: Ask the reporter to confirm campus-wide scope or specify affected buildings/floors
location_resolution.ground_floor_policy: Do not create a ground floor for the Academic Block; it has 1st, 2nd, and 3rd floors.
location_resolution.underground_auditorium: Associated with the 1st floor; stairs descend somewhat underground. Preserve the user-provided name.

room_code_rules.CL: Computer Lab. In the Academic Block, CL codes refer only to computer labs; do not infer other lab types.

examples.LH103: Lecture Hall/classroom, Academic Block, floor 1, room 03

room_code_rules.format_policy: Use only explicitly documented or user-confirmed codes. Do not generate room IDs by guessing. Preserve the original reported location text and request confirmation for unverified codes.
